R_definition: Peer-only balanced empirical CRPS minus day-shrunk personal-mixture CRPS for log1p(2h-standardized displacement/0.1km)
claim_scope: Exploratory one-source adult-female herd patterns; no cross-taxon inference or causal partitioning claim

limitations: A single reference group label does not establish social association, shared locations, or a common resource pool.
Missing deployment dates prevent independent interval validation even when animal/tag pairs match uniquely.
Absent HDOP, satellite counts, and error estimates prevent quantitative GPS accuracy gating.
Only recorded source outlier flags are honored; no movement-speed exclusions or movement-effect filters are used.
Year cohorts reuse biological individuals and must not be treated as independent animals.
event_audit.source_clock: native naive timestamps; UTC versus GPS clock not independently verified

step_audit.step_origin: source timestamp, date, month, hour bin, and position

uncertainty: Individual/pair empirical distributions and declared scale/origin sensitivities; no population confidence intervals or biological p-values
